events.verdict: Replay review of the foul called on Allen (CLE) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Allen leaves his leg extended into Jokic's (DEN) path, initiating body contact that affects his shot attempt in the post.
Hardaway Jr. (DEN) establishes himself in Allen's (CLE) path prior to the contact.
Allen (CLE) maintains a legal guarding position during Jokic's (DEN) post-up and shot attempt.
Jokic (DEN) reaches in and makes contact to the ball, which Mitchell (CLE) legally recovers before making the pass.
Hardaway Jr. (DEN) legally contests Tyson's (CLE) jump shot attempt.
Johnson (DEN) and Merrill (CLE) engage during the rebound and Merrill loses his balance attempting to get to the ball out of reach.
Tyson (CLE) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Harden (CLE) obtains a legal guarding position in front of Jokic (DEN), who loses control of the ball after bringing his arm into Harden.
Murray (DEN) moves alongside of Mitchell's (CLE) path to the basket and as he retreats away, Mitchell briefly bobbles the ball after bringing his arm into Murray.
Johnson (DEN) dislodges Allen (CLE) from his rebounding position.
Harden (CLE) abnormally extends his leg as he returns to the floor to create the marginal lower body contact with Hardaway Jr. (DEN).
Braun (DEN) establishes himself in Tyson's (CLE) path prior to the contact and the two players briefly engage and disengage following the pick.
Tyson (CLE) legally contests Hardaway Jr.'s (DEN) jump shot attempt.
Murray (DEN) is late to the spot and turns into Mitchell (CLE), initiating illegal body contact.
Mitchell (CLE) is in a legal guarding position during Jokic's (DEN) shot attempt.
